[quote=tartakum;60278448][b]Funding[/b]
Tartakum notices recent trouble with both sides of the conflict. Tartakum recently has sales from the Amaralo People's Army, and the Astaniran National Forces. Tarta will be selling weaponry to these 2 sides, and will be selling smaller guns to the Aggrossian Militas.
Tarta is not planning to be hiding its weapons selling activity to the other sides. Weapons, gear, and armor will arrive at their respective port. Tarta is also selling a new kind of ATGM, the "Glopnir 6". This is an wire guided APFDS that can Peirce heavy armor. It is bigger than a standard shell, but still extremely fast. By selling this, Tarta hopes to further it's name in the defence industry. [nation]Astanir[/nation]

(Fixed it up)[/quote]
[b]Responses[/b]

Upon hearing of the news that the nation of Tartakum was offering to sell weapons to them, the Amaralo people's army would meet it with suspicion. Firstly, they did not understand what Tartakum had to gain from their faction winning the war as Tartakum is a middle-power on Shamat, whereas this faction maintains a pro-amaralo doctrine. Additionally, the open sale of weapons to the Astaniran national forces would further push the Amaralans away from the deal, seeing the National army as one of their primary opponents. For these reasons, the Amaralo people's army would decline the trade deal.

The various Argossian tribes and militias would have a similar response. Tartakum did not seem to gain anything from supporting the Argossians, especially given the fact that they had decided to sell minimum equipment to the faction. All of the contacted argossian militias would therefore decline the trade deal too, out of suspicion and lack of gain.

The Astaniran national forces would consider the deal more carefully. They were eager to end the civil war they had inadvertantly sparked as quickly as possible and knew that they would need all the support they could get. Despite this, upon discovering that Tartakum had blatantly and openly offered weapons to two other factions which the army sought to eliminate, decided to also decline on the basis that they simply could not trust the government of Tartakum.

[b]Re-Trial/b]
Tarta arms manufactured had seen that their plan failed greatly. Due to the misunderstanding, Tartakum has sent a letter to the Amarillo peoples army that stated, "The reason we are wanting to give you weaponry is so that we can have it battle tested. In fact, we will throw in a few extra gear such as some BMP's. The second reason is for democracy to prevail. We have been observing the tactics of the National army, and we dislike what they do to civilians and others. Seeing them put out of power would be a plus for the world. Please reconsider. -Chairman of the Board of Aid at the Ministry of Defence."
